card.title: Quality Director – Aerospace & Defense
card.description:
A designer and manufacturer of advanced defense systems in Columbus, MS is hiring a Quality Director to lead its quality management system. You'll sit on the site's senior leadership team, with the visibility of a smaller company and the backing of a large global parent.

What you'll do:

* Lead the quality management system and maintain AS9100 and Nadcap certifications
* Lead, train and develop the quality team
* Set, track and report quality KPIs to leadership
* Lead root cause investigations and corrective/preventive actions
* Respond to customer quality concerns and manage supplier quality
* Lead internal, customer, supplier and certification audits
* Partner with management on site-wide quality initiatives

What you'll bring:

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field
* Quality management experience in manufacturing, ideally aerospace or defense
* Proven supervisory and leadership experience
* Experience leading AS9100 / ISO certifications; Nadcap audit experience strongly preferred
* Strong root cause, metrics and continuous improvement background
* Ability to travel occasionally, including out of state and internationally
* Must be a U.S. person under export control rules

Pay: $150,000.00 - $170,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Relocation assistance
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* How many people have reported to you in a quality leadership role?

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* Quality management: 5 years (Required)
* AS9100: 3 years (Required)

License/Certification:

* AS9100 Lead Auditor (Required)

Work Location: In person

card.title: Director, Quality - Aero-Glen International
card.description:
**Overview Of The Position**
The Director of Quality provides strategic direction and operational oversight for the company’s Quality Assurance and Quality Control functions. As the principal owner of the company’s Quality Management System (QMS), this role is accountable for maintaining compliance with AS9100, AS9120, and applicable customer and regulatory requirements; driving continuous improvement; and ensuring that Aero Glen consistently delivers products and services that meet the highest standards of quality, reliability, and customer satisfaction.
 
 
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Establish and execute the company's quality strategy in alignment with business objectives, customer expectations, and applicable industry requirements. Develop measurable targets and provide visibility of quality performance and risks.
* Develop and manage the department’s staffing plan, training strategy and resource requirements. Ensure clarity of accountability, roles, responsibilities and decision making throughout the quality organization.
* Balance customer requirements, compliance obligations, operational efficiency, and business performance without compromising product conformity or regulatory compliance.
* Maintain overall accountability for the effectiveness and continual improvement of the company's AS9100- and AS9120-certified Quality Management System, ensuring operating procedures are approached with a risk-based thought process and effectively integrated and monitored.
* Oversee the company’s audit program ensuring readiness and execution of internal audits, external certification audits and customer audits. Maintain relationships with certification bodies, auditors and external stakeholders. Execute effective and timely responses to all notifications, findings and corrective actions.
* Evaluate the quality and compliance implications of new contracts, acquisitions and significant business process changes.
* Manage the supplier quality management program, including supplier approval, qualification, monitoring, risk assessment, and performance evaluation.
* Oversee the investigation and resolution of customer quality issues, including root cause analysis, containment, corrective action, and effectiveness verification. Utilize structured analysis methods such as 5Whys and 8 Disciplines in response to quality issues.
* Oversee processes and controls for first article inspection and receiving inspection, including inspection plans, workflow and disposition of non-conforming materials. Ensuring that inspection activities are well documented and appropriate for product or vendor risk, customer expectations and company procedures.
* Partner with Sales, Supply Chain and Operations to identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives to address reoccurring deficits in process, performance or product.
* Handle Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) for assigned accounts and Federal Contract Information (FCI) as required.

**Other Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**

* Demonstrated ability leading a team to achieve business objectives.
* Demonstrated ability to identify process issues and drive process improvement.
* Open-minded self-starter with the ability to adapt, improvise and problem solve.
* Ability to work independently on multiple tasks and projects with various stakeholders.
* Organizational skills to manage transactional details.
* Experience supporting organizational growth, acquisitions or system implementations preferred.
* LEAN certification highly desired.
* Experience managing and maintaining current quality assurance control principles.
* Exceptional Microsoft Office proficiency (Excel, Access, PowerPoint Presentations).

card.title: Director Quality
card.description:
Reporting to the President, C.E.O., Directs and coordinates activities of personnel at all Hutchinson
 
Sealing Systems facilities engaged in Quality Management System to prevent or eliminate defects in
 
new or existing products or process by performing the following duties personally or through
 
subordinates. This position is designated as a sensitive function for quality, engineering,
 
manufacturing, supplier, audit, compliance, and operational information, including quality performance
 
data, customer requirements, product and process development information, audit findings, corrective
 
actions, supplier performance records, and proprietary company information.

We are 40 000 men and women who meet the challenges faced by our automotive, aviation, defence and industry customers every day. Our passion for challenge and our enthusiasm encourage us to imagine, design and produce high performance and innovative fluid, sealing system and anti-vibration solutions. Working at Hutchinson means being curious about everything, contributing to the evolution of mobility and reducing carbon emissions.
 
 
Join us and show what drives you!
 
 
A French company with an international presence (25 countries): 170 years of history and passing on our know-how.
 
5 billion in turnover, with 5% invested in R&D.

**SUMMARY:**

Reporting to the President, C.E.O., Directs and coordinates activities of personnel at all Hutchinson Sealing Systems facilities engaged in Quality Management System to prevent or eliminate defects in new or existing products or process by performing the following duties personally or through subordinates. This position is designated as a sensitive function for quality, engineering, manufacturing, supplier, audit, compliance, and operational information, including quality performance data, customer requirements, product and process development information, audit findings, corrective actions, supplier performance records, and proprietary company information. The incumbent is responsible for protecting the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets in accordance with company policies and customer requirements.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

* Analyzes, evaluates, and presents information concerning factors such as quality performance, production capabilities, manufacturing problems, customer quality trends, and quality planning of new products for consideration by other members of the management team.
* Presents and evaluates alternative methods and procedures to establish standardized quality systems based on best practices.
* Participates with other top management personnel in formulating and establishing company policies, operating procedures, and goals.
* Participates in review of product development activities and APQP milestones.
* Conducts Quality System Management review meetings with top management to assess performance and compliance to customer quality requirements.
* Reviews technical problems and procedures of departments and recommends solutions to problems or changes in procedures.
* Confers with engineers and managers about quality assurance of new products and process to improve manufacturing capability.
* Reviews technical publications, articles, and abstracts to stay abreast of technical and quality system developments in industry.
* Travel required on a frequent basis to suppliers and customer facilities as well as other Hutchinson facilities.
* Provides internal quality system audit of Hutchinson Sealing Systems locations.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

Master's degree (M.A.) or equivalent; or four to ten years' related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Qualifications may be waived by management. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:**

None.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Manages subordinates in department. Is responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of this unit. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complains and resolving problems.

**TEAM SKILLS:**

Hutchinson is built around teamwork. This position requires the use of good team skills such as cooperation, information sharing, task sharing, timely completion of assignments, good listening and communication skills and overall respect for other team members.

**LANGUAGE SKILLS:**

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret common scientific and technical journals, financial reports, and legal documents. Ability to respond to common inquiries or complaints from customers, regulatory agencies, or members of the business community. Ability to write speeches and articles for publication that conform to prescribed style and format. Ability to effectively present information to top management, public groups and/or boards of directors.

**MATHEMATICAL SKILLS:**

Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry. Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.

**COMPUTER SKILLS:**

Ability to use word processing, spreadsheet applications. Must be familiar with internet research, Microsoft Office software, and the use of e-mail.

**REASONING ABILITY:**

Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT:**

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts. The employee is occasionally exposed to fumes or airborne particles; toxic or caustic chemicals. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and talk or hear. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close, vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

**HEALTH AND SAFETY:**

Must actively support our Health Safety and Environmental policy, immediately report all Safety hazards and correct them when able to safely do so, participate in all required Safety Training, meetings, inspects, and use all required PPE.

card.title: Director of Plant Operations
card.description:
Lasko is seeking a Director of Plant Operations to lead our manufacturing facility in Franklin, Tennessee. This leader will oversee plant performance, with accountability for safety, quality, delivery, cost, and employee development.
 
 
The Director will translate business priorities into effective operating plans, strengthen manufacturing processes, and build a culture of accountability and continuous improvement. Working closely with Supply Chain, Engineering, Quality, Human Resources, and Finance, this individual will ensure the facility consistently delivers quality products while improving productivity, controlling costs, and supporting Lasko’s growth.
 
 
The ideal candidate is a visible, hands-on leader who builds strong teams, uses data to guide decisions, and maintains a consistent presence on the production floor.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**
*Plant Leadership and Operational Performance*

* Lead daily plant operations, coordinating production, maintenance, manufacturing support, and material flow to meet safety, quality, cost, and delivery objectives.
* Develop and execute operating plans that align production capacity, staffing, equipment, and materials with business requirements.
* Establish clear performance expectations and operating metrics; review results regularly and drive corrective actions when performance falls short.
* Partner with Supply Chain and production planning teams to manage schedules, respond to changing demand, and maintain reliable customer service.
* Resolve operational challenges quickly while implementing lasting solutions that prevent recurring issues.

*Safety, Quality, and Compliance*

* Champion a culture in which employee safety is a daily priority and leaders take ownership of safe work practices.
* Oversee plant safety, environmental performance, and facility security in partnership with the appropriate support teams.
* Ensure consistent adherence to company policies, operating procedures, and applicable requirements.
* Partner with Quality and Engineering to improve process controls, reduce defects and rework, and ensure finished products meet established standards.
* Support audits, investigations, and corrective actions, ensuring timely follow-through and sustainable improvements

*Continuous Improvement and Manufacturing Excellence*

* Lead continuous improvement initiatives that increase throughput, improve equipment reliability, reduce waste, and strengthen overall plant performance.
* Apply Lean manufacturing principles, root cause analysis, standard work, and structured problem-solving to improve operating processes.
* Use production, quality, maintenance, and cost data to identify performance gaps and prioritize improvement opportunities.
* Partner with Maintenance and Engineering to strengthen preventive maintenance programs and address equipment constraints.
* Support new product introductions, process changes, and manufacturing readiness to achieve successful production launches.

*Financial and Resource Management*

* Develop and manage plant operating budgets, monitor spending, and take action to address cost variances.
* Improve labor productivity, material utilization, energy efficiency, and material handling costs while maintaining safety and quality standards.
* Partner with Finance and Supply Chain to strengthen inventory accuracy, control work in process, and support effective inventory management.
* Identify and prioritize capital investment needs; develop business cases for equipment upgrades, automation, and facility improvements.
* Ensure people, equipment, and materials are deployed effectively to meet production commitments.

*People Leadership and Development*

* Build, coach, and develop a strong plant leadership team with clear responsibilities and measurable goals.
* Partner with Human Resources on workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, training, performance management, and employee relations.
* Foster a respectful, collaborative environment that encourages employee involvement, open communication, and ownership of results.
* Develop leadership capabilities and succession plans to support long-term operational stability.
* Maintain effective communication across shifts and departments to ensure consistent priorities and execution.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Progressive experience in manufacturing operations, including substantial leadership responsibility for plant performance and people management.
* Demonstrated success leading a manufacturing facility or a significant manufacturing operation with responsibility for safety, quality, delivery, cost, and employee development.
* Strong understanding of production planning, inventory control, equipment maintenance, quality systems, and manufacturing cost drivers.
* Experience developing and managing operating budgets, evaluating capital investments, and improving financial performance.
* Demonstrated ability to lead continuous improvement initiatives and deliver measurable operational results.
* Strong analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance immediate production needs and longer-term priorities.
* Effective communication skills and the ability to work across all levels of the organization.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, and experience using ERP systems and manufacturing performance data.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in consumer products or another high-volume manufacturing environment.
* Familiarity with injection molding, assembly operations, automation, and related manufacturing processes.
* Experience leading operations across multiple shifts and managing seasonal changes in production demand.
* Lean or Six Sigma training or certification.
* Experience leading organizational change, developing plant leaders, and strengthening employee engagement.

*Work Environment*
This position is based onsite at Lasko’s Franklin, TN manufacturing facility and requires regular presence on the production floor. Flexibility is required to support plant operations across shifts and address business needs.
 
 
**About Lasko Products**
***Love Your Air*
™**
Lasko Products is the leading air solutions brand with a reputation for reliable products, peak performance, and perpetual innovation – our commitment to our customers for over a century. Founded in 1906 by Henry Lasko in Philadelphia, Lasko has evolved for over a century to become the global leader in air solution products. From our roots in small appliances, fans, and portable heaters, we’ve grown to become the leading home comfort company while maintaining our unwavering commitment to quality and value. Today, Lasko stands as a symbol of innovation, offering consumers around the world high-performance products; portable fans, heaters, air purifiers, humidifiers, and home ventilation solutions. Our well-known brands, Lasko, B-Air, BlueDri, Air King, and Guardian Technologies, serve both consumer and commercial markets across North America and internationally. As an American company for 120 years, we take pride in upholding the spirit of hard work, trust and accessibility, ensuring that Lasko remains available to all, for generations to come. Headquartered in West Chester, Pennsylvania, with manufacturing and distribution facilities in Tennessee and Texas, Lasko intends to set the standard in the air solutions category for another 100 years.
 
 
***Lasko’s mission is to provide comfort you can trust.***
Our company’s success is based on our culture of
**GRACE**
, with five core “
*Be*
” values outlining how we live it.
 
 
**Growth Mindset —**
*Be Bold*

* We are never the finished product ─ every failure is a data point, every setback is a setup.

**Recognition —**
*Be Together*


* We win together. We celebrate together! High performance deserves to be seen ─ named, specific, remembered.

**Authenticity —**
*Be Real*

* No masks. No politics. Show up as you are, say what you mean, and mean what you say.

**Clear Communication —**
*Be Clear*

* Say it plainly. Say it once. Say it to the right person. Clarity is kindness.

**Extreme Ownership —**
Be
*Accountable*


* No blame. No excuses. Own the win and the loss. No exceptions.

**Why Join Lasko?**
At Lasko, we believe people do their best work when they’re supported ─ personally and professionally. That’s why we offer flexible hours and a hybrid work schedule for our corporate team, promoting employees to balance life and work in a way that fits their lifestyle. Our dog-friendly corporate headquarters adds a fun, welcoming atmosphere, while our competitive salaries with bonus potential recognize and reward your contributions. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes a strong 401(k) match, wellness incentives, and robust health coverage. Join Lasko and be part of a legacy of innovation – at a company that values flexibility, growth, and a culture where you can thrive.

card.title: Regional Quality Director - NA
card.description:
**Job descriptions may display in multiple languages based on your language selection.**
**What We Offer**
At Magna, you can expect an engaging and dynamic environment where you can help to develop industry-leading automotive technologies. We invest in our employees, providing them with the support and resources they need to succeed. As a member of our global team, you can expect exciting, varied responsibilities as well as a wide range of development prospects. Because we believe that your career path should be as unique as you are.
 
 
**Group Summary**
Transforming mobility. Making automotive technology that is smarter, cleaner, safer and lighter. That’s what we’re passionate about at Magna Electronics, and we do it by creating world-class Electronic systems. We are a premier supplier for the global automotive industry with full capabilities in design, development, testing and manufacturing of complex Electronic systems. Our name stands for quality, environmental consciousness, and safety. Innovation is what drives us and we drive innovation. Dream big and create the future of mobility at Magna Electronics.
 
 
**Job Responsibilities**
**Role Summary**
The Regional Quality Director will be responsible for QM systems with regard to Product Portfolio, Programs and Projects to secure quality according to effective internal and external standards such as QS 9000, ISO/TS 16949/IATF, 14001, 18001, VDA, MQS, etc. to meet Legal, Company and Customer requirements and standards.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Ensure effectiveness of the Magna Electronics Quality Management (QM) System.
* Managing all QM activities with regards to execution and achievement of corporate Quality goals.
* Executing the global quality strategy and goals, in particular the achievement of certified QM systems in the Division and Engineering Centers.
* Track and maintain data analysis of key metrics and performance data as it relates to the global quality strategy and results.
* Support Division management in executing quality policies; improve the sense of quality ownership in employees by corresponding measures, including establishing standards.
* Support Divisions and Engineering Centers to achieve site targets and ensure Lessons Learned / Best Practice in respect of Quality.
* Support Divisions and Engineering Centers in cases of containments, customer and warranty claims; executing root cause analysis, corrective actions and verification of effectiveness.
* Ownership in change management systems with respect to all quality-system related subjects.
* Engage in internal Program and Project reviews of Program Management and customer meetings in aspects of Quality.
* Interact with Division Quality, Production Operations, Product Development and Program Quality to meet or exceed internal and external customer quality performance targets.
* Support the sales and purchasing team in customer negotiations and supplier quality relevant topics.
* Engage in Quality advance planning and execution and support launch activities to meet timing and quality standards.
* Promote quality performance improvement throughout the organization.
* Ensure QM systems correspond to Magna Corporate and ME Group Requirements.
* Maintains regular attendance.
* Follows safe work procedures; Uses appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE); Uses workplace tools and equipment as instructed; Reports workplace hazards, injuries and illness as soon as possible following event.
* Complies with the requirements of Magna Quality System (MQS).

**Key Qualifications/Requirements**

* Excellent knowledge in effective quality standards within the automotive industry
* Knowledge of implementing and maintaining QM systems and its auditing/assessment internal and external dealing with suppliers and customers
* Experience with presentation and moderation techniques
* Comprehensive knowledge of APQP/PPAP
* Excellent knowledge in use of statistical methods and Quality Core Tools (e.g. SPC, 8D, 5Why, Ishikawa, FMEA & CP, etc.)
* Comprehensive knowledge of Root cause analysis and Problem Solving Methods (e.g. Shainin, Red X, Six Sigma, etc.)

**Education**

* Technical degree in Mechanics or Electronics required. Experienced in Quality Operations; Quality Manager/Director. Minimum of 10+ years’ global quality management experience working within the automotive electronics industry.

**Experience**

* 10+ years of progressive quality leadership experience within the automotive electronics industry, including responsibility for multi-site or regional quality management systems.
* Demonstrated experience leading quality strategy, certified QM systems, audits, customer quality performance, and continuous improvement initiatives across manufacturing and engineering environments.
* Proven ability to partner with Division, Engineering, Program Management, Operations, Sales, Purchasing, and customer teams to resolve complex quality issues and improve performance.
* Experience leading containment, warranty, customer claim, root cause analysis, corrective action, and verification of effectiveness processes.
* Prior experience as a Quality Manager, Quality Director, or equivalent senior quality leadership role in a global or matrixed organization.

**Awareness, Unity, Empowerment**
At Magna, we believe that a diverse workforce is critical to our success. That’s why we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire on the basis of experience and qualifications, and in consideration of job requirements, regardless of, in particular, color, ancestry, religion, gender, origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity. Magna takes the privacy of your personal information seriously. We discourage you from sending applications via email or traditional mail to comply with GDPR requirements and your local Data Privacy Law.
 
 
**AI-Assisted Screening Disclosure**
As part of our commitment to a fair, consistent, and efficient recruitment process, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in the initial screening of applications submitted through our Workday system. These tools help identify qualifications and experience that align with the role requirements. Please note that AI is used solely to support our recruiters. Final decisions are always made by the hiring manager and the hiring team. Importantly, no applicant data is shared externally through these AI tools. All information remains securely within our systems and is handled in accordance with our privacy and data protection policies.
 
 
**Under conditions defined by applicable law, you may have the right to request an explanation of how AI is used to support decision-making.**
If you have any questions or concerns about this process, feel free to contact our Talent Attraction team.
 
 
**Worker Type**
Regular / Permanent
 
 
**Group**
Magna Electronics

card.title: Director, Quality
card.description:
At Ensign-Bickford Aerospace & Defense Company (EBAD), we believe that our strengths are built on our most important resource - our people. Join EBAD and you'll be a part of a team who creates cutting edge technology that will blast us into the future. No other company can match the innovative energetic solutions that we provide. At EBAD you will actively contribute to successful missions putting men, women and satellites into space, and protecting our armed service men and women around the world. If this is the culture and work environment you are seeking, then EBAD is the place for you!
 
 
**Job Description**
**Location:**
Simsbury, CT
 
 
**Reports to:**
VP of Operations
 
 
**Industry:**
Aerospace & Defense
 
 
**Experience Level:**
Director (15+ years)
 
 
**Shape the Future. Deliver Excellence. Achieve Zero Failure.**
At
**Ensign-Bickford Aerospace & Defense (EBAD),**
we’ve been innovating for nearly
**200 years,**
delivering mission-critical technologies that protect lives and advance exploration. As we prepare to double in size over the next 3–5 years, we’re investing in our people and culture to support this transformation.
 
 
We’re seeking a dynamic
**Director of Quality**
to lead a complex, multi-site quality organization and drive performance at scale. Based at our headquarters in Simsbury, Connecticut, this role is critical to ensure the highest levels of product integrity, compliance, and customer trust across a rapidly growing business. This is not just about maintaining standards but about building a future-state vision for quality that enables growth, safeguards mission success, and strengthens EBAD’s reputation as a trusted partner.
 
 
**The Opportunity:**
EBAD’s customers depend on us to deliver our products with zero failure in mission-critical environments. The Director of Quality will be responsible for developing and executing a strategic Quality Management System (QMS) while leading quality operations across multiple sites. This leader will be tasked with driving measurable quality improvement, while also championing a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
 
 
This is an exciting opportunity for a leader to make an immediate impact by providing direction, driving the strategy for the business, and developing a problem-solving culture.
 
 
**Core Competencies for Success:**

* Quality & Compliance Leadership: Proven success leading complex, multi-site quality organizations in aerospace, defense, or other high-reliability industries, with expertise in zero-failure mission environments.
* Continuous Improvement & Performance: Skilled in EBOS, Lean, and Kaizen practices with the ability to drive metrics-based improvement and systemic problem-solving.
* Team Development & Leadership: Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and build strong teams while fostering engagement and accountability.
* Collaboration & Influence: Strong cross-functional partnership with credibility to influence senior leadership, customers, and suppliers.
* Resilience & Adaptability: Able to manage ambiguity, drive change, and motivate teams in a fast-scaling environment.

**The Candidate We Are Looking For:**

* BS in an engineering discipline (MS preferred)
* Minimum 10 years of experience in high-mix, low-volume operations and manufacturing environment
* Proven success leading complex, multi-site quality organizations in aerospace, defense, or other mission-critical industries
* Demonstrated expertise in leading audits and managing compliance across regulatory bodies, customers, and suppliers, with deep knowledge of standards such as AS9100, ISO9001, and DoD requirements
* Proven ability to enhance customer quality by partnering closely with engineering, operations, and supply chain teams to consistently meet customer demand
* Strong record of measurable quality improvements
* Skilled in continuous improvement, performance metrics, and problem-solving through EBOS, Lean, and Kaizen practices
* Track record of building and developing strong teams, fostering high engagement, and driving accountability

**A Defining Leadership Opportunity:**

* Legacy: Join a privately held, 188-year-old business that takes a long-term approach, free from the short-term pressures of quarterly-driven reporting.
* Impact: Lead a mission-critical function where zero failure is the standard and success is business-defining.
* Partnership: Work directly with the BU President, senior leadership, and enterprise HR leaders in a highly influential role at the intersection of people and business strategy.
* Culture of Excellence: Help shape a culture that values people, integrity, and mission-driven excellence, driven by a Kaizen mindset and a commitment to quality and continuous improvement.

**Ready to Make a Difference?**
If you’re a proven quality engineering leader with the vision, discipline, and drive to achieve zero failure in a complex and growing business, this is your opportunity.
 
 
**Compensation and Rewards:**
We recognize that world-class leaders deliver world-class impact, and we reward accordingly. This role offers a competitive executive package that includes:
 
 
**Base Salary:**
$175k – $225k plus annual bonus
 
 
**Executive Relocation:**
Comprehensive support for a seamless transition
 
 
**Additional Enhancements:**
Potential sign-on incentives and tailored rewards based on experience
 
 
*We offer a competitive compensation package aligned with skills & experience, with flexibility to reward top talent and extraordinary qualifications.*
*Ensign-Bickford Aerospace & Defense Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE). Qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, genetic information, national origin, or veteran status.*

card.title: Sr Manager - Manufacturing Engineering
card.description:
**About us:**
At Plexus, our vision is to help create the products that build a better world. Driven by a passion for excellence, we partner with leading Aerospace/Defense, Healthcare/Life Sciences and Industrial companies to design, manufacture and service some of the world’s most transformative products, including advanced surgical systems, diagnostic instruments, healthcare imaging equipment, mission critical aerospace systems, and electric vehicle (EV) charging solutions. Visit Plexus.com to learn more about our unwavering commitment to our vision.
 
 
**When we invest in our people, we invest in building a better world.**
With a vision rooted in the wellbeing and inclusive engagement of our team members, our customers, their end users and our communities, people are the heart of what we do and who we are. It is our values that unite us and guide us in everything that we do, including how we operate, behave and interact to foster a workplace where every team member feels valued and empowered to contribute their best.
 
 
Our values include: Growing our People, Building Belonging, Innovating Responsibly, Delivering Excellence and Creating Customer Success.
 
 
As a team member, you will engage in impactful work through global collaboration and the use of emerging technologies, join an inclusive culture where every team member is valued and working toward a greater purpose, and be empowered to reach your full potential through various development programs designed to accelerate your growth.
 
 
Plexus offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support team members' wellbeing, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, retirement savings, and opportunities for professional development. We also prioritize work-life balance and offer a variety of perks to enhance the team member experience. For more information, visit our US benefits website at usbenefits.plexus.com. Our commitment to pay range transparency fosters an equitable workplace, where everyone can feel valued. The annual compensation range for this position is stated below. The salary offered within this range will be based upon the geographic location, work experience, education, licensure requirements and/or skill level. Salary Range:
 
 
$132,500.00 - $198,700.00
 
 
**Purpose Statement:**
To provide leadership and direction to the Manufacturing Engineering team(s) from a functional perspective. Manage the Manufacturing Engineering function in line with functional specific strategies, process and systems development, people development, employee relations, plant level metrics.
 
 
**Key Job Accountabilities**

* Lead manufacturing-engineering excellence by collaborating with various functional leads to ensure engineering capability meets or exceeds manufacturing standards for quality product delivery.
* Support Program Management initiatives and activities to meet or exceed customer expectations.
* Lead process/product/equipment engineering activities in compliance with Plexus Core Values to meet industry standards, regulatory and customer requirements.
* Provide technical leadership to site operations, establish a technology roadmap, and collaborate with corporate and regional technical teams to achieve lower costs and higher manufacturing returns.
* Responsible to exemplify and hold their team accountable to demonstrating the Plexus Core Values. Leader will focus on evaluating potential, driving succession planning, and ensuring their employees receive the development and coaching required to realize their full potential.

**Education/Experience Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree with 8 or more years of related experience is preferred. An equivalent combination of education and/or experience will be considered.
* Proven leadership skills and management experience.

*This document does not represent a contract of employment and is not intended to capture every possible assignment the incumbent could be asked to perform.*
We are pleased to provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities or special requirements. If you need an application accommodation, please contact us by email at GHQ.TA@plexus.com. Please include your contact information and clearly describe how we can help you. This email is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.
 
 
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE) and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
 
 
Some offers of employment are contingent upon successfully passing a drug screen and/or background check.

card.title: Sr Director - Advanced Manufacturing Engineer - NPI
card.description:
**Job Description**
Be part of the global Integrated Supply Chain (ISC) Engineering leadership team driving factory improvements, product improvements for producibility and cost savings, manufacturing technology implementation, and new product development for Honeywell Aerospace.
 
 
We are hiring a Sr Director to lead the global ISC Advanced Manufacturing Engineering (AME) team for New Product Introduction (NPI) supporting programs across the Aerospace portfolio.
 
 
In this role, you will leverage your extensive product development experience and leadership skills. You will drive continuous improvement to develop new products, processes, and standards in support of the organization's business strategies with a direct impact on development program success. You will develop strategy, hold teams accountable and deliver high impact business results.
 
 
**Responsibilities**

* Deliver NPI program objectives including product producibility, design-to-cost (DTC) targets, production readiness, and customer quality.
* Operate as a change agent to embed producibility into our core design processes.
* Build Employee Engagement and Skills through the development of standard work, clear roles and responsibilities, and effective training programs.
* Design and develop Management Operating Systems to ensure effective team operations, driving results to program and department objectives.
* Work closely with the SBU engineering team, Program Management, and ISC leaders to build cross-organizational alignment

**Qualifications**
**YOU MUST HAVE**

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in a technical discipline such as the sciences, technology, engineering or mathematics
* 8 years of experience in New Product Development
* Knowledge of manufacturing processes
* Experience working with suppliers on technical issues
* Track record of managing multiple projects with demonstrated results on a macro scale
* Experience leading a team with direct line reporting responsibility
* Abitlity to travel 30%

**Us Person Requirements**
Due to compliance with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidate must be a U.S. Person, which is defined as, a U.S. citizen, a U.S. permanent resident, or have protected status in the U.S. under asylum or refugee status or have the ability to obtain an export authorization.
 
 
**WE VALUE**

* Advanced degree in engineering or business
* Exceptional data analysis and communication skills
* Willingness to raise standards each year to drive organizational excellence
* Ability to make sound and timely judgments in ambiguous environment
* Ability to convey subtle or complex messages clearly, as appropriate for the topic and audience.
* Diverse and global teaming and collaboration
* Balance between demand and capacity when establishing priorities for the organization.

**For Mn Candidates**
The annual base salary range for this position is $238,000-$297,000. Please note that this salary information serves as a general guideline. Honeywell considers various factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate's work experience, education and training, key skills, as well as market and business considerations.
 
 
This position is incentive eligible.
 
 
**Benefits**
Beyond a performance-driven salary, you'll work alongside dedicated experts on technology that's advancing aviation. As a Honeywell Aerospace employee, you're eligible for a comprehensive benefits package that includes:
 
 

* Employer-subsidized medical, dental, vision and life insurance
* Short-term and long-term disability coverage
* 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts and health savings accounts
* Employee assistance program and educational assistance
* Parental leave and 12 paid holidays
* Paid time off for vacation, personal and sick time

Explore your benefits: https://honeywellaerospacebenefits.com/
 
 
**POSTING TIMELINE**
The application period for the job is estimated to be 40 days from the job posting date; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.
 
 
Join a company that's reintroducing itself to the aviation community we've helped advance for more than a century. At
**Honeywell Aerospace**
(NASDAQ: HONA), we're launching as an independent, publicly traded aerospace and defense company built on a legacy of operational excellence and mission-focused execution.
 
 
Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. With our systems on board 90% of the world's aircraft, your work here has reach that's rare to find anywhere else.
 
 
Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next.
 
 
Every horizon. Every mission. Every day.
 
 
Honeywell Aerospace Products And Services Are Found On Aircraft Across Commercial Aviation, Defense And Space. We Operate Through Three Business Areas
 
 
Electronic Solutions develops the avionics, navigation systems, sensors and electromagnetic defense technology on board 90% of the world's aircraft
 
 
Engines & Power Systems provides the propulsion, auxiliary power and electrical systems that keep those aircraft flying
 
 
Control Systems supplies the thermal and motion control systems that support takeoff, landing and the safety of everyone on board
 
 
With approximately 58,000 employees worldwide and net sales of $17.4B in 2025, we are also advancing systems for autonomous and supersonic platforms — bringing the same focus on safety and efficiency to the next era of flight. Explore our businesses: https://www.honeywellaerospace.com
 
 
Join Honeywell Aerospace! Our aerospace innovations bring people together, make the world safer and more secure, and help humankind reach for the stars. Now we’re shaping aviation’s future with sustainable aviation fuels, smarter cockpits, ultra-efficient engines, smart airports, flying taxis and much more.

card.title: Vice President of Quality
card.description:
**Vice President of Quality**

**Growing Engineering & Advanced Manufacturing Business**

**Connecticut**

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Vice President of Quality to join a growing, established engineering and manufacturing business.

This is a key leadership appointment, offering the opportunity to shape and develop the quality function, drive operational excellence and embed a proactive culture of quality across the organisation.

The business is continuing to grow and invest in its manufacturing capabilities, making this an important role in ensuring that quality systems, processes and standards evolve in line with its ambitions.

We are particularly interested in hearing from individuals with a background in precision engineering, aerospace or advanced manufacturing, where quality, technical accuracy and process control are fundamental to business performance.

**The Opportunity**

Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, you will take overall responsibility for the strategic direction and operational delivery of the Quality function.

A key priority will be to move quality beyond a reactive, inspection-led approach, working closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Production and Supply Chain to identify the root causes of issues, implement sustainable corrective actions and prevent recurrence.

You will play a highly visible, cross-functional role, influencing how the business operates and ensuring quality is embedded at every stage of the manufacturing process.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and develop the Quality function, establishing a clear strategy, measurable objectives and a culture of continuous improvement.
* Drive a proactive approach to Quality Assurance, focusing on identifying the underlying causes of process and product issues rather than simply addressing the symptoms.
* Work collaboratively with Engineering, Manufacturing, Production and Supply Chain to improve process capability, product consistency and operational performance.
* Lead root cause analysis, corrective and preventative action (CAPA) and structured problem-solving initiatives.
* Oversee the Quality Management System, ensuring robust processes, compliance and readiness for internal, external and customer audits.
* Develop and monitor quality KPIs, using data and trend analysis to identify opportunities for improvement and drive accountability.
* Take ownership of supplier quality, working with key suppliers to improve standards, resolve issues and strengthen supply chain performance.
* Partner with Engineering on new product introduction, design changes and manufacturing process improvements.
* Develop, coach and lead a capable quality team, building technical expertise and accountability throughout the function.
* Work closely with the senior leadership team to ensure quality initiatives support wider business objectives, customer satisfaction and continued growth.

**The Ideal Candidate**

We are looking for a commercially aware and technically credible Quality leader who can operate strategically while remaining close enough to the manufacturing operation to understand where and why issues occur.

**You will ideally bring:**

* Significant senior-level Quality leadership experience within a precision engineering, aerospace, advanced manufacturing or similarly demanding engineering environment.
* A strong background in Quality Assurance, Quality Management Systems and manufacturing process control.
* Proven experience of leading root cause analysis and driving effective, lasting corrective actions across complex manufacturing processes.
* The ability to work cross-functionally, influencing Engineering, Operations, Production and Supply Chain teams to improve quality performance.
* A good understanding of machining, manufacturing processes, materials and engineering specifications.
* Experience with continuous improvement methodologies, statistical process control and quality performance metrics.
* Experience managing customer and supplier quality, audits and regulatory or industry compliance requirements.
* Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to develop teams and influence at all levels of an organisation.
* A relevant engineering or science degree, alongside substantial Quality Management experience, would be advantageous.

card.title: Director, Manufacturing Engineering
card.description:
L3Harris is dedicated to recruiting and developing high-performing talent who are passionate about what they do. Our employees are unified in a shared dedication to our customers’ mission and quest for professional growth. L3Harris provides an inclusive, engaging environment designed to empower employees and promote work-life success. Fundamental to our culture is an unwavering focus on values, dedication to our communities, and commitment to excellence in everything we do.
 
 
L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security.
 
 
***Job Title: Director, Manufacturing Engineering***
***Job Code: 47622***
***Job Location: Camden, AR***
***Job Schedule: 4/10: Employees work 10 hour days, 4 days a week***
**Job Description:**
The Manufacturing Engineering Director in Camden, Arkansas will plan, organize and technically direct the manufacturing engineering activities and staff. Enable Operations to execute all programs in a safe and efficient manner, and ensuring the achievement of quality, cost and delivery schedule objectives. This position reports to the Senior Director Operations and Site Management. Our Camden, AR site is at $600M+ revenue and produces a diverse portfolio of highly engineered products for aerospace and defense applications. The individual will be responsible for implementing a disciplined operating system in line with the enterprise while improving the operating effectiveness of the site and leading an organization of over 190 people.
 
 
**Essential Functions:**

* 50% - Direct and lead technical team: Analyze, evaluate and determine appropriate solutions for manufacturing technical problems encountered in the application of manufacturing methods, facilities and processes. Apply engineering procedures, provide technical direction, create and apply work instructions and tooling for the factory floor. Participate in program and site corrective action boards and be a key member in customer escape and non-conformance investigations; develop direct cause, root cause and mistake proof corrective actions, as well as separation criteria when required. Ensure proper deployment of resources to achieve cost effective results in support of site and business unit deliverables. Direct the installation of Electronic Work Instructions (Platform is DELMIA) across the site and all product lines. Strict oversight of the Job Safety Analysis and Process Safety Management programs at the site.
* 15% - Administrative management: Ensure a safe work environment and remain in compliance to federal and local regulations. Develop long range technical and administrative plans, goals and strategies.
* 15% - Customer interface: Establish priorities to meet the needs of the customer and the organization with a dedication to support the manufacturing shop floor. Represent the organization as a prime internal and customer contact on manufacturing technical operations.
* 20% - Strategy and Continuous Improvement: Lead the sites Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) program. Drive operational

excellence throughout the organization and create a metrics driven, highly accountable mindset within the organization.
 
 

* Ability to obtain a US secret security clearance.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree with a minimum of 15 years prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree with a minimum of 13 years prior relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 19 years of prior relevant experience.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated supervisory and leadership skills, including planning, organizing and directing activities; developing talent; and collaborating across business units and functional teams to achieve site objectives.
* Strong understanding of business development, program management, engineering, finance, operations and process control, with the ability to engage effectively with plant-floor teams, customers and executives.
* Experience in aerospace and/or general industrial sectors, including multiple years in a leadership capacity, with program management, engineering leadership and experience with inert, energetic and propellant materials.
* High-energy, results-driven leader with a disciplined work ethic, a bias for action and a continuous improvement mindset. Able to drive commitments to closure, elevate performance and lead organizational change in a demanding environment with lean staffing.
* Ability to satisfy federal government requirements for access to government information.

L3Harris Technologies is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. L3Harris is committed to treating all employees and applicants for employment with respect and dignity and maintaining a workplace that is free from unlawful discrimination. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding or other related medical conditions), gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, disability, genetic information, citizenship status, characteristic or membership in any other group protected by federal, state or local laws. L3Harris maintains a drug-free workplace and performs pre-employment substance abuse testing and background checks, where permitted by law.
 
 
Please be aware many of our positions require the ability to obtain a security clearance. Security clearances may only be granted to U.S. citizens. In addition, applicants who accept a conditional offer of employment may be subject to government security investigation(s) and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.
 
 
By submitting your resume for this position, you understand and agree that L3Harris Technologies may share your resume, as well as any other related personal information or documentation you provide, with its subsidiaries and affiliated companies for the purpose of considering you for other available positions.

card.title: Sr. Staff Manufacturing Engineer, General Assembly & Test, Optimus
card.description:
**What To Expect**
Tesla is seeking a highly motivated Sr. Staff Manufacturing Engineer to build and lead a team of engineers focused on high-volume production launches. This role will drive the development of scalable manufacturing systems while collaborating with cross-functional teams to optimize product designs for manufacturability, accelerate assembly processes, and implement automation solutions. In this fast-paced, demanding environment, you’ll play a pivotal role in scaling Tesla’s SI robotics initiatives while advancing our mission to achieve sustainable abundance through innovative manufacturing practices.
 
 
**What You'll Do**- Lead Manufacturing Engineering Team: Build, mentor, and scale high-performing teams to design and deploy high-volume production systems, ensuring alignment with Tesla’s speed and quality objectives
- Collaborate with Equipment Suppliers: Partner with internal and external suppliers to engineer, install, and validate production equipment, accelerating line ramp-up to meet volume targets
- Validate Requirements and Constraints: Use first principles analysis to rigorously assess product and process requirements, eliminating ambiguity and ensuring all elements are purpose-driven and essential
- Optimize Production Processes: Identify and remove non-value-added steps in workflows, prioritizing functional simplicity before pursuing automation or advanced optimization
- Improve Cycle Time: Analyze production bottlenecks and implement solutions to increase process speed, throughput, and overall line efficiency
- Deploy Automation Solutions: Strategically integrate automation as a final step after process simplification, ensuring systems are robust, high-speed, and scalable
- Ensure Seamless Operational Transitions: Coordinate with operations teams during ramp-up phases, delivering detailed documentation and training to sustain engineering teams for long-term success
**What You'll Bring**- First Principles Thinking: A rigorous mindset focused on breaking down complex problems to their fundamental truths, enabling innovative solutions to manufacturing challenges
- Proficiency in CAD tools (Catia and AutoCAD preferred) for designing and optimizing production systems
- Deep knowledge of mechanical assembly techniques (pressing, fastening, harnessing, etc.) and electrical integration, including quality control matrices, testing protocols, and troubleshooting methodologies
- Familiarity with torque tools, automation equipment, control systems, and communication protocols (e.g., PLC, HMI, SCADA)
- Production Transition Experience: Demonstrated success in scaling products from prototype to high-volume production, ensuring seamless handover to sustaining teams
- Resilience & Adaptability: Ability to thrive in high-pressure environments while managing competing priorities and tight deadlines
- Communication & Organization: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, paired with meticulous attention to detail and a highly organized approach to documentation and process handover
- Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical or Electrical engineering, or equivalent experience
**Benefits**
Along with competitive pay, as a full-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire:
 
- Medical plans > plan options with $0 payroll deduction
- Family-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
- Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution
- Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High-Deductible medical plan with HSA
- Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
- 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits
- Company paid Basic Life, AD&D
- Short-term and long-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
- Employee Assistance Program
- Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays
- Back-up childcare and parenting support resources
- Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft & legal services, and pet insurance
- Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs
- Tesla Babies program
- Commuter benefits
- Employee discounts and perks program
- Earned Wage Access: Real-time pay access paid daily, subject to eligibility and schedule (applicable for below Sr. Managers levels)
Expected Compensation
 
 
$156,000 - $276,000/annual salary + cash and stock awards + benefits
 
 
Pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.
 
 
, Tesla
